name: Memora Health
long_description: Memora Health helps healthcare organizations digitize and automate complex care workflows, making them simple for patients and clinicians to navigate. Memora ingests existing data on clinical workflows, converts them into cohesive messaging journeys that guide patients through their care episodes, and automates the completion of simple follow-up tasks in the EMR. Memora's platform reduces care team notifications by nearly 40%, has a >70 average NPS, and has improved clinical outcomes across various populations. Contact us at info@memorahealth.com
one_liner: Digitize and Automate Complex Care Workflows

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio:
Founder and CEO of Novitas Holdings, which invests in and acquires technology businesses. Former co-founder and CEO of Memora Health (W18), a workflow automation platform for health systems. Memora raised over $80M from leading investors such as a16z and GC, and was acquired by Commure in 2024.

Interests range from computational biology to health policy to tech. Prev. worked as a researcher at the CDC and lectured in medical informatics at Penn and Georgia Tech.

founders.title: Founder/CPO
founders.founder_bio: Surgeon, health AI researcher, and angel investor. Former co-founder of Memora Health (YC W18), an enterprise care navigation company, which was acquired by Commure.
